acceleration_basis: fixed RPS/work plus shorter physical slots changes workload exposure, averaging support, phase duration and initialization/refresh information; cadence ratios alone do not preserve the original physical-time estimand; no validated equivalence or settling contract

engineering_verification.stale_pending_test: queue 250m/128MiB then 500m/256MiB while first accepted target awaits reconciliation; older unsent intent superseded; no overlapping patch

fixed_limit_basis: 2 * pre-existing 512MiB maximum reservation; strictly greater than all requests to retain Burstable QoS; not selected from treatment outcomes
memory_endpoint: time integral of observed kubelet allocated reservation; desired request and fixed limit separate; not reclaimed RAM or hardware cost
memory_qos: require runtime capture; MemoryQoS disabled baseline; no memory.min/low protection assumed

pending.acknowledgement_timeout: acceptance unknown; keep unresolved target, fail closed, no next patch
pending.api_rejection: explicit API/contract rejection; no physical enforcement claimed; fail closed
pending.operational_harms: retain deferred/rejected/timeout failures and trial termination; no selective rerun or successful full-window endpoint fabrication
pending.timeout: terminal operational failure with right-censoring, never finite success; no automatic retry

qos: Burstable from creation; no QoS transition

settling.enforcement: ACK + spec + allocated reservation + status + cgroup CPU quota + fixed memory.max + observed generation + no resize condition + Ready + stable identities

mechanical_window.basis: one configured 5s HTTP-I/O timeout interval, not a total-request deadline; explicit registry establishes drain; 20 unchanged-work completed responses establish health/progress, not stationarity

shortest_physical_design.note: retain predeclared 48h exposure per treatment; do not opportunistically shorten from favorable timing
shortest_physical_design.repetitions: not chosen; existing precision/randomization/hardware gates remain

telemetry.host_admission: physical program order and local monotonic order
